historical_crash_evidence.run18_mode: SIGSEGV si_code=2 at 0x379b81a99801 (SEGV_ACCERR in V8 cage mprotect RW region), exit=null/timeout
historical_crash_evidence.run18_sequence: mmap(0x379b81a80000, 0x7f000, PROT_NONE) -> madvise DONTDUMP -> munmap(0x379b81ac0000) -> mprotect(0x379b81a80000, 0x40000, RW) -> [later] SIGSEGV at 0x379b81a99801
historical_crash_evidence.observation: Two distinct crash modes. SEGV_ACCERR (si_code=2) at address inside mprotect'd RW region = candidate for mprotect semantics bug or guest/host translation error, not necessarily PT-walk race.

hypotheses_to_distinguish: H1: V8 guard-page fault valid but guest signal delivery broken
H2: Blink mprotect semantics wrong (returns success but page remains NONE)
H3: Guest-to-host address translation returns wrong page or permissions
H4: Concurrent PT-walk observes freed/stale state (race/lifetime bug)
